title: Switch
description: Fiori switch: icon, textual (on/off text) and graphical (semantic) designs, read-only state.

usage.summary: Turn a setting on or off with an immediate effect.
useWhen: Let users turn a setting on or off and see the change take effect immediately.
Place a descriptive label above or before the switch so both states have a clear meaning.
Prefer the default icons over text inside the track to avoid localization problems.

avoidWhen.when: Review settings before submission, select independent options or express an ambiguous on/off statement.
Activate or deactivate a secondary toolbar feature.
